description: Number of Ports Upgraded to 10GB is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (performance.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. Number of ports upgraded to 10 gigabyte capacity on the County's data network. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Government. Its tags are communications, network, internet. The table has 3 columns. The portal shows 2015-09-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-performance-smcgov-org-portal.
